questions.question: What is the value of each 2 in 62 027 503?
questions.expected_answer: The first 2 is in the millions place, so it is worth 2 000 000. The second 2 is in the ten thousands place, so it is worth 20 000.

questions.question: Write three hundred and five million, forty thousand and nine in digits, and explain the zeros.
questions.expected_answer: 305 040 009. The zeros hold the empty places: there are no ten millions, hundred thousands, thousands, hundreds or tens, so each of those seats gets a 0.
